			set_variable = { global.JAP_te_region_active = 104 }
			IJN = { set_country_flag = IJN_te_region_104 }
			JAP_te_launch_run_effect = yes
		}
	}

	# carry [?JAP_te_rounds|.0] / [?JAP_te_band|.0]). The idle card lives in
	# JAP_tokyo_express.txt (hand-written).
